units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 10:13">Erub. X, 13</cite> (<cite ref="Eruvin 103a:6">103ᵃ</cite>) <he>חותכין י׳ וכ׳</he> (Rashi in ed. Sonc. <cite ref="J00040"><he>יַבּוֹלֶת</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) you may cut off (on the Sabbath) a wart of an animal in the Temple.

<cite ref="Eruvin 103a:6">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 6:1">Pes. VI, 1</cite> <he>חתיכת יַבַּלְתּוֹ</he> the cutting of its (the sacrifice’s) warts; <cite ref="Pesachim 68b:2">ib. 68ᵇ</cite> (<he>י׳</he>) <cite ref="L00336"><he>לחה</he></cite> a moist wart, <cite ref="J00073"><he>יבשה</he></cite> whose neck is dried up; a. e.—Pl. <he>יַבָּלוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 6:7">Neg. VI, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 2:12">Tosef. ib. II, 12</cite> <cite ref="J00154"><he>יובלת</he></cite> (corr. acc.); Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 1, ch. II <he>יַבּוֹלוֹת</he>, distinguished fr. <he>דלדולים</he> or <cite ref="V00639"><he>תלתלים</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="D00806"><he>דִּלְדּוּל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 2:2:2">Y. Shebi. II, 33ᵈ</cite> top (expl. <he>מיבלין</he>, not <he>מזבלין</he>, Mish.) <he>מעבירין את היַבּוֹלֶת</he> to remove excrescences; v. <cite ref="J00050"><he>יָבַל</he> II</cite>.
